hypotheses.title: Promethazine Extends Lifespan in Drosophila
hypotheses.claim: Promethazine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. The compound increases median and maximum survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Promethazine modulates histaminergic and dopaminergic signaling and reduces oxidative stress, pathways implicated in aging regulation across animals.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies receiving promethazine will show statistically significant increases in median and maximum lifespan compared with vehicle controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Run a standard survival assay with age-synchronized flies on food with and without promethazine, using multiple doses, and analyze mortality curves with log-rank statistics.

hypotheses.title: Procaine HCl Shortens Lifespan in Drosophila
hypotheses.claim: Procaine HCl shortens lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. The compound decreases median and maximum survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Procaine HCl alters membrane excitability and local anesthetic pathways, and chronic perturbation of such signaling can impose physiological costs that accelerate mortality.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies receiving Procaine HCl will show statistically significant decreases in median and maximum lifespan compared with vehicle controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Run a standard survival assay with age-synchronized flies on food with and without Procaine HCl, using multiple doses, and analyze mortality curves with log-rank statistics.

hypotheses.title: Procaine HCl Extends Lifespan via MAO Inhibition
hypotheses.claim: Procaine HCl extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inhibiting monoamine oxidase and elevating dopamine signaling. Increased dopaminergic tone suppresses age-related neurodegeneration and mortality.
hypotheses.rationale: Monoamine oxidase inhibition preserves monoamine neurotransmitters and dopamine signaling supports stress resistance and neural maintenance, both of which influence longevity.
hypotheses.prediction: Procaine HCl-treated flies will live longer than controls and show reduced monoamine oxidase activity and elevated dopamine levels.
hypotheses.experiment: Measure lifespan, monoamine oxidase activity, and dopamine concentrations in flies fed Procaine HCl versus vehicle, and test whether dopamine pathway manipulation abolishes the survival effect.

hypotheses.rationale: Pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate chelates metals and suppresses inflammatory transcription factors, and reduced oxidative and inflammatory burden can slow aging in a sex-dependent manner.

hypotheses.experiment: Run a standard survival assay with age-synchronized male flies on food with and without pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate, using multiple doses, and analyze mortality curves with log-rank statistics.

hypotheses.title: Pyrolidine Dithiocarbamate Extends Lifespan via NF-kB
hypotheses.claim: Pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inhibiting NF-κB signaling. Suppression of NF-κB-driven inflammatory transcription reduces age-related mortality.
hypotheses.rationale: NF-κB signaling drives chronic inflammatory gene expression that accumulates with age, and its inhibition lowers tissue damage and preserves organismal function.
hypotheses.prediction: Pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate-treated flies will live longer than controls and show reduced NF-κB transcriptional activity.
hypotheses.experiment: Measure lifespan and NF-κB reporter activity in flies fed pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate versus vehicle, and test whether NF-κB pathway activation abolishes the survival effect.
